text:
Sam (Sales): FYI Lighthouse Health wants a POC — they want to onboard a custom MedQA model (gpt-med-lite v2) plus an L2 quantized variant. Key asks: compatibility with our catalog, KV cache behavior, customer KMS, private/VPC-only. Also need committed pricing for Dedicated (4x A10G) and any enterprise blockers.
Anya (Solutions): quick q — what’s their traffic pattern and sequence lengths? that drives batch/kv sizing.
Sam (Sales): avg input ~512 tokens, expected response ~256, target sustained ~100 QPS with bursts to ~400 qps for ~20–30s. HIPAA workload, customer will supply keys (KMS), no egress allowed, must be on Private deploy.
Cameron (ML Eng): gpt-med-lite v2 looks like a 13B-ish decoder stack? L2 quant variant should be supported but we need to validate tokenizer/embedding offsets and LM-head differences. main risk is KV cache memory pressure at high qps — recommend testing with realistic prefix lengths.
Jules (Platform): we can do Private + Dedicated. KMS integration supported (customer-managed keys) and VPC-only networking is fine. For headroom on those burst patterns I’d lean 8x A10G, but 4x could work if we set autoscale/burst and pad with fallback model to keep latency SLOs.
Marta (Security): note from security side: need completed security questionnaire + HIPAA addendum signed, inbound/outbound firewall allowlist, and an account-scoped audit log plan. Who’s the Lighthouse security contact?
Sam (Sales): they said security@lighthousehealth.com for the questionnaire. Can we get a checklist for onboarding items we can hand them? Also need committed pricing (4x vs 8x) and overage rules to put in the SOW.
Anya (Solutions): ballpark from CS/Finance: committed 4x A10G private cluster ~ $12k/mo, 8x ~ $22k/mo. Overage rate typically ~1.5x of committed unit. exact quote will go via sales ops.
Cameron (ML Eng): for the compatibility run — suggest these steps: 1) tokenizer sanity, 2) model forward/LLM sampling, 3) quant-variant smoke test, 4) KV cache stress (long prefixes), 5) perf profile across seqlens. Example quick perf call for lab:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/infer \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \\ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-med-lite-v2","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":256}'
```
We’ll run with a harness to simulate QPS burst. I can provide the harness config.
Jules (Platform): @Cameron please open a Dedicated onboarding ticket (include KV mem profile and quant test results). I’ll provision a private cluster and pre-wire KMS.
Sam (Sales): thanks — I’ll collect the questionnaire this afternoon and schedule the POC kickoff next Tue. Also can we get an expected timeline for onboarding steps?
Jules (Platform): timeline: token/compat sanity + quant smoke — 2 business days; KV/perf stress — 3 business days; security/contracting parallel — 5–10 business days; total expected POC readiness ~1–2 weeks depending on signature and access.
redwood-bot: :page_facing_up: Onboarding ticket created — #ONB-1429 (assigned to Jules). Please add any artifacts there. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Sales): perfect — I’ll drop the questionnaire and sample data into #ONB-1429 and loop in Lighthouse sec. :thumbsup:
